title: Correction to: How Important Is Budding Speciation for Comparative Studies?
content: This is a correction to: Daniel S Caetano, Tiago B Quental, How Important Is Budding Speciation for Comparative Studies?, Systematic Biology, Volume 72, Issue 6, November 2023, Pages 1443–1453, https://doi.org/10.1093/sysbio/syad050.
